name: team_planning_set_departure
description: Have a person leave in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, optionally naming the position that backfills them: it carries the budget and the headcount, and the leaver never counts as filling it. In this scenario's step they stay on the map marked as leaving; in the steps after it they are gone and the position stands alone. team_planning_withdraw_departure has them stay. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. Keep personal details out: deleting the plan erases the note, forgetting a person does not.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

position_id.description: The backfill: a position the scenario has. Leave it out when the seat isn't backfilled.
